newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telephone and Data view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telephone and Data view cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc on Thursday lowered its estimate for Telephone and Data Systems Inc's 1997 earnings to $0.75 from $0.80 and the estimate for 1998 to $1.65 from $1.79.

-- EVEREN said the estimate cuts reflect adjustments it is making to its model for the company's US Cellular division. The unit yesterday posted lower-than-anticipated operating income and earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization.
-- EVEREN continues to rate the company market performer for the intermediate term and outperform for the long term.
-- Telephone and Data provides communications services.
-- Its shares were trading up 3/8 Thursday at 37-5/8.
